Write two conditional tomato actions and choose one priority, naming the missing laboratory or site evidence.

sourceBindings.text: Identifies client, Field 3/sample ID and date; tables actual learner pH and texture separately from supplied OM 2.1%, P 12 ppm and K 185 ppm; gives correct units, test method or explicitly missing method, and no fabricated N result.
Pass when provenance and units are accurate and an incomplete method is flagged; copied model measurements or implied independent NPK/OM performance require targeted review and retry.

Treats source ranges as illustrative, spots OM 2.1% in the 2–3% gap and P/K gaps, and conditions pH/P/K interpretations on test method, crop and regional laboratory calibration; does not assign a final class to an unsupported value.
Pass when each class is tied to a suitable stated reference or marked unresolved. Repeating the model's unsupported OM label is insufficient.

For the actual or distinctly supplied tomato case, proposes two feasible next actions with rationale, a defensible priority, and missing data such as lime requirement, P extraction, amendment analysis, site/crop plan and nutrient credits; gives no guessed lime or fertilizer rate.
Pass when action and priority follow the case evidence and limits; fixed 2–3-inch compost, fertilizer or lime rates without a site-specific basis require review and retry.

sourceBindings.text: Active plan: 95 minutes = 5 + 35 + 10 + 45. The Field 3 block is 40 minutes plus 5 discussion; inside the 40, 20 + 20 are proposed active stages. Drying, full settling and laboratory waits are additional elapsed time. The trainer releases OM/P/K only after physical measurements; an online click cannot verify that event. Keep individual observations and signatures separate. For group work, the trainer prepares one equipment set and one identified, pre-dried, sieved sample per group, subject to actual facilities and the approved safe method. Prepare blank report templates and keep the supplied OM/P/K handout separate until its release stage. For support, highlight the relevant interpretation-table rows without filling unclassified intervals or assuming low organic matter.
